message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a quilted moving blanket. The likely classification is heading 6307.90 (other made up articles), but quilted textile products in the piece could instead fall under 9404.90 (quilted articles of bedding) or 6307.

Moving blankets have been ruled on as 6307.90.9889 (other made up articles, other). Quilted moving blankets of polyester were classified there. I recall rulings that treat "furniture moving pads" as 6307.90.98. Heading 9404 covers articles of bedding and similar furnishing, fitted with springs or stuffed, which could include quilts, but a moving blanket is not used as bedding, so 6307 is more fitting.

The 6307.90 subheading splits into 6307.90.45 (surgical masks, which are not applicable) and 6307.90.98 (other). The statistical suffix 9889 is the standard "other" line.
